AlertDefinition.name: Supply Allocation Missing
AlertDefinition.Source: select distinct item.itemKey,s,item, item.itemNumber,a.responsibility.responsibilityKey from Item item,ItemAssignment a, PcmAlertSubscription s join s.options o where a.item = item and exists ( select 1 from Avl avl where avl.item = item ) and s.user.userId = a.userId and s.alertType = 'SupplyAllocationMissing' and s.subscribeFlag = 1

Detail.Label: @{name} alert for @{item}
Detail.Body: An allocation for @{item} does not exist for today

Noop.Expression: not exists ( select 1 from PcmSupplierAllocation sa where sa.customerItem = item and (trunc(sysdate) between sa.effectiveFromDt and sa.effectiveToDt) or (trunc(sysdate) >= sa.effectiveFromDt and sa.effectiveToDt IS NULL)

List.name: SupplyAllocationMissingResponsibility
List.Expression: exists (select 1 from s.options o where o.optionId = 'Responsibility' and (lower(o.optionValue) = lower('All') or lower(o.optionValue) = lower(a.responsibility)))
